setting.includePath: Extra folder with C++ headers, passed to the compiler as CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH.
setting.python: Python interpreter. Empty means python on Windows and python3 elsewhere.
setting.timeLimit: Time limit of one test, in milliseconds.
setting.companionPort: Port that receives problems from the Competitive Companion browser extension.
